title: Foundational Phonics, Grammar, and Sentence Layouts (Day 161)
description: Identifying basic parts of speech, capitalization rules, and complete punctuation.
concept: Words align systematically to convey clear, simple baseline statements.
bullets: Nouns name specific people, geographical locations, or physical things.
Verbs inject structural action changes into a sentence row.
Sentences require a complete thought block to achieve structural readability.
cross_reference: Proverbs 25:11 — A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
